description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultMuteableConnectionLogger class, which implements a connection logger with muting capabilities. The tests verify muting/unmuting behavior, logging suppression when muted, and correct delegation of log methods when unmuted. It also includes tests for equals/hashCode and ensures that internal interactions with dependencies like ConnectionLogger are as expected.
